\[
G_x = (p\, d^{\mathsf T}) \star I,
\qquad
G_y = (d\, p^{\mathsf T}) \star I
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(d\): The 5-tap derivative, about -0.110, -0.277, 0, 0.277, 0.110
- \(p\): The 5-tap prefilter, about 0.038, 0.249, 0.426, 0.249, 0.038

d is a 5-tap derivative and p a 5-tap prefilter, a smoothing. Farid and Simoncelli optimized them together, so that d is the derivative of p as closely as possible. That makes the gradient direction accurate in every direction. The taps are those of skimage.filters.farid.
